title: Overnight load persists
action: Check the BMS schedule and verify whether an overnight activity was planned.

title: Meter stops reporting
action: Check gateway connectivity and missing interval backfill.

title: Isolated demand spike
action: Compare the interval with equipment start logs and neighboring meters.

title: HVAC running after hours
action: Review the HVAC schedule, overrides, and actual occupancy. Cause requires confirmation.

title: Sudden demand spike
action: Correlate with large equipment starts. Inspect finer-resolution data if available.

title: Telemetry gap
action: Check the meter gateway and communications before attributing this to a power outage.

title: Expected solar output falls
action: Compare inverter telemetry, cloud cover, and curtailment commands.

title: Unchanging meter readings
action: Verify the meter timestamp and gateway cache; request a fresh reading.

title: Unexpected charging peak
action: Review charger sessions and the managed charging schedule.

title: Baseload gradually rises
action: Check persistent equipment loads and compare cooling demand with weather.

title: Overnight HVAC load returns
action: Check recurring schedule overrides; confirm the change with the facility team.

title: Reactive demand increases
action: Review reactive power and equipment state. Confirm with suitable power-quality measurements.

title: Small overnight increase, first recurrence
action: Compare the same overnight window across multiple days.

title: Small overnight increase repeats
action: Inspect repeated overnight operation; each reading remains below the point limit.

title: Third small overnight increase
action: Review recurring schedule overrides across nights.

title: Persistent modest daytime increase
action: Inspect a sustained sequence that individual point limits miss.

title: Concurrent recreation meter gap
action: Compare other meters before treating this as an isolated device problem.

title: Concurrent student center meter gap
action: Check for a shared collection or communications problem.
